goal: Maximize useful-work duty cycle without paid API or always-on user PC while preserving single substantive authority and durable monotonic state.

layers.target_latency: predecessor ACTUAL END + exactly 1 minute (60 seconds) target plus provider jitter
layers.mechanism: Mutate SAME MAIN recurring DTSTART aggressively; judge success by useful-work duty cycle and actual wake latency, not second-perfect dispatch.

nonnegotiable_invariants: GitHub main is durable source of truth
same MAIN canonical remains enabled until terminal or explicit operator stop
same MAIN recurring RRULE is cold fallback

capability_evidence.prior_failures: Earlier shifted wakes sometimes fell through to natural-hourly fallback; preserve as evidence but do not treat second-level dispatch as the goal.
capability_evidence.utilization_first_wake_20260922_094058: Observed MAIN invocation at 09:40:58.959 KST against a 09:40:53 KST target: about 5.96 seconds late. This is a successful low-idle wake for utilization purposes and directly contradicts treating all dynamic shifted occurrences as provider failures.
capability_evidence.interpretation: Provider behavior is variable rather than categorically incapable. Continue measuring actual idle gap/duty cycle and keep the mechanism simple when it works.

current_blocker: Reduce inter-turn idle time while avoiding control-plane complexity that suppresses otherwise useful self-updates.
next_test: Use the working minimal self-update pattern as baseline: same automation, aggressive next target, compact durable checkpoint, immediate useful work. Add guards only when observed duplicate/stale side effects require them.
